quote_candidates.text: We forecast that over the next four years, global Internet and media revenues will grow by approximately $300 billion, continuing to outpace GDP growth
Access will lead revenue growth for tech and media companies
Reality Computing enables rich, immersive experiences that will lead to the next big computing platform
The winners in Reality Computing are far from decided — players will emerge to fill new opportunities
The future winners in television and video streaming will look quite familiar to consumers
Smaller SVOD services will face extreme consumer acquisition challenges if not acquired or distributed by established players
Overall, consumers will dramatically increase their time spent watching digital video
The recent spike in news subscriptions mirrors a broader industry shift away from advertising and toward cultivating dedicated paying audiences
These 15 players are largely marketplace platforms — where tens of millions of sellers will continue to fuel growth
